job.job_description:
Key Responsibilities:

Develop intuitive, responsive, and dynamic user interfaces using JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js, Next.js, HTML, CSS, and Tailwind CSS

Build robust backend services and RESTful APIs using Node.js and Python

Design, manage, and optimize NoSQL databases using MongoDB,SQL

Handle application deployment and server configuration using Docker, Linux, VPS, and Nginx

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver high-quality software solutions

Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement in code quality and development practices

Troubleshoot and debug applications across multiple environments

Required Skills:

Proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript

Experience with React.js, Next.js, HTML, CSS, and Tailwind CSS for frontend development

Working knowledge of Node.js and Python for backend development

Experience with MongoDB for NoSQL database management

Familiarity with deployment tools and environments, including Docker, VPS, Linux, and Nginx

Strong understanding of web development fundamentals and RESTful APIs

Good problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn and grow

We are looking for a passionate and self-motivated Full Stack Developer with 01 year of experience to join our growing team in a hybrid role based in Gurugram. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining end-to-end web applications, including frontend, backend, database, and deployment layers.


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
